title: SubscribeEquityRequest
description: Phase 2 (watchlist-trigger): request from WatchlistTriggerWorkflow to market-data-svc to subscribe a real-time equity trade stream for a ticker. The market-data worker, on each MEANINGFUL move (min-move throttle against trigger_level x equity_emit_delta_pct), signals signal_name on the named workflow with an EquityTick payload. Mirrors SubscribePremiumRequest's tenant/strategy scoping.

ticker.description: Underlying equity symbol to subscribe (e.g. NVDA).

target_workflow_id.description: Target workflow_id to receive equity-tick signals (the WatchlistTriggerWorkflow child).

signal_name.description: Signal method name to invoke on the target workflow for each emitted tick (e.g. equityTick).

trigger_level.description: Reference price level T (the leg's trigger). Used as the min-move throttle base: a new tick is emitted only when |last - lastEmitted| >= equity_emit_delta_pct * T.

equity_emit_delta_pct.description: Minimum fractional move (of trigger_level) before a new tick is emitted. Throttles tick volume to keep workflow history bounded.
